newsitem.title: UK: Majority BA ground staff vote for strike.
newsitem.headline: Majority BA ground staff vote for strike.

text.p: The Transport and General Workers Union (T&G) said a majority of British Airways ground staff had voted in favour of strike action in protest over BA's plans to sell its catering unit.
T&G said 9,508 workers, representing 90 percent of BA's ground staff were balloted, out of which 69 percent had returned their votes. It said 62.5 percent of them had voted in favour of the strike.
This verdict comes as a double blow for BA, which saw its cabin crew pass a 73 percent vote in favour of strike in a separate ballot last week.
The two ballots stem from different issues but are both linked to BA's cost-cutting moves to save 1.0 billion pounds ($1.7 billion) by 2000.
T&G officials told a news conference that there will be a meeting later on Monday with BA's cabin crew staff to discuss whether they would go ahead with a strike.
A similar meeting with the ground staff was scheduled for Tuesday morning, with a final decision expected later his week. ($ = 0.601 British Pounds)
